capabilities: Run AI actions from slash commands typed in notes
Mention AI agents like @betty inline with vault context
Chat with a persistent, vault-aware AI widget
Build multi-step workflows in a visual node editor
Define custom agents, commands, and triggers as markdown/YAML files
disambiguation: Not just a chat assistant; most of its automation runs through a separate Spark engine installed outside Obsidian.
extras: Automation triggers (e.g. file-change-triggered workflows) are listed as planned, not implemented. Users must install a companion Spark engine (auto-installs Node.js); API keys are stored encrypted in ~/.spark/secrets.yaml. Extensive docs live outside the README on linked pages.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to trigger AI actions and multi-step automations directly from notes and file changes.

relations.evidence: MCP Protocol - Model Context Protocol for service integrations

summary: AI assistant that adds slash commands, agent mentions, a vault-aware chat widget, and a visual workflow builder, driven by a companion file-based engine.
